svg.title: Joint dispatch and charging policy
svg.desc: Joint dispatch and charging policy · H3 · 35 AMRs · 3 charging slots · compared with FIFO · Completed transports · Higher is better · FIFO · 878 · Joint RL · 913 · Battery depletions / 1,000 · Lower is better · FIFO · 0.60 · Joint RL · 0.30 · Simulation results; the comparator is FIFO, not nearest-request dispatch.
